reason: I pay the contractors myself by bank transfer, so my bank statement already is my expense list. I might forward a few screenshots to try the free 30, but I would not pay $19 a month for a sheet of payments I already made and can see.
objection: If something is paid twice or a total is wrong, that is my site manager or the contractor cutting corners. A bot flagging it does not fix the people, and I still have to chase them myself from abroad.
would_change_my_mind: If it caught the receipts my site manager pays in cash that never show up in my bank, and compared them against the build budget so I could see overspend before I send the next transfer.
